name: Canadian Wildlife Habitat Conservation Stamp Program
summary: One-year grants of C$1,000 to C$150,000, matched 1:1, for conserving and restoring priority wetland and waterfowl habitat across Canada. The 2027-28 round closed on 18 October 2026.
reporting: Interim reports due mid-September and final reports due mid-March of each grant year.

applicant_types.quote: Research, academic, and educational institutions; For profit organizations such as small businesses, companies, corporations, and industry associations; Local organizations such as community associations and groups, seniors' and youth groups, and service clubs; Provincial, territorial, municipal, and local governments and their agencies.

geography.quote: to fund conservation projects supporting NAWMP priorities across Canada.

access.quote: Eligible organizations have until October 18, 2026 to apply online via WHC's grant portal.

amount.quote: Have a funding request between $1,000 and $150,000 Canadian dollars

co_finance_required.quote: Clearly demonstrate a minimum 1:1 funding match ratio

approaches.quote: Research projects support a better understanding of waterfowl and habitat conservation in NAWMP priority areas.

reporting.quote: Reporting periods: Interim Reports due mid-September 2025 Final Reports due mid-March 2026
